title: Smoked Pork Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful recipe for pork skewers with a smoky twist. Perfect for a quick summer dinner.
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger. Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the pork.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
While the pork is cooking, mix together olive oil and sesame seeds in a small bowl.
Once the pork is cooked, brush the sesame oil mixture onto the skewers.
Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and garnish with green onions.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
